title: Phase 3: Real tier tests — providers, ZFS, multi-runtime
description:
Implement real tier tests with real LLM providers and infrastructure (Plan 22 §4.4, §5.2-5.3, §6-9):

- tests/e2e/test_deployment_modes.py — Real tier tests for configs C1-C6 (fleet, direct, agent-sandbox)
- tests/e2e/test_provider_api.py — Real LLM provider API tests for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter (§9)
- tests/e2e/test_zfs_durability.py — ZFS durability: write file, shutdown, remount, read back (§6)
- tests/e2e/test_sandbox_identity.py — Hostname verification in sandboxes (§7)
- tests/e2e/test_multi_runtime.py — Claude Code + Codex sandboxes, cross-runtime context transfer (§8)
- tests/e2e/test_sandbox_config.py — Agent-in-sandbox (§5.2), mixed mode (§5.3)

Runs on local machine only (not CI). Uses real credentials from secrets file. Port scheme: orchestrator 28080, sandbox-host 28082/28083.

References: docs/plans/22-e2e-external-tests.md §4.4, §5.2-5.3, §6-9
